annotations.title: Decide on a Phở analysis plan

description: Record the user's decision on a Phở analysis plan: approve runs it, request_changes sends the user's note so Phở revises the plan (it comes back to plan_review), deny stops the session (a denied trial is not used up). Call it only with the user's own decision, never on their behalf. Pass approval_id and payload_hash exactly as get_analysis_run returned them.

note.description: Required for request_changes: what the user wants changed.
